text:
Nora: Heads-up OrchidAnalytics onboarding is seeing big tail latency & cost on long-context exports. Renewal in 5d. p95 jumps to ~8.2s on 15k-token jobs. Need a low-risk perf plan we can run today. :worried:
Liam: Oof. Model + route + quant state?
Nora: They're on `gptx-3-8b` (hosted default). No quant. Pattern: nightly export batch jobs + occasional long interactive calls.
Ezra: Quick mitigation idea (min disruption): 1) Micro-batch scheduled exports to amortize KV work; 2) Route large/batch jobs to a dedicated compact-int8 variant with larger KV cache; 3) Add prefix caching for repeated headers.
Priya: Agree. Also propose a "soft-quant" profile: int8 for weights + keep layernorm/softmax in fp16 to reduce token-level drift. Low risk compared to full int4.
Liam: Eval checklist: a) 12 canonical export prompts (real customer samples) b) run baseline vs compact-int8 c) metrics: p95, token throughput, perplexity, a small hallucination spot-check. Plan ~90m.
Nora: Fallback rules? Don't want canary to take them down mid-renewal week.
Ezra: Fallback: if cohort error-rate > 0.8% OR p95 > 10s -> instant reroute to hosted-default. Also keep sampling of 40 responses to cs-audit bucket.
Priya: Routing rule example I can push:
```
# route config (pseudocode)
if request.headers['X-Job-Type']=='export' or prompt_tokens >= 4096:
  route -> dedicated-compact-int8-usw2
else:
  route -> hosted-lowlatency
```
Include customer tag guard so only OrchidAnalytics traffic hits this path.
Liam: I'll run the eval now. Quick script:
```
./eval.sh --base=gptx-3-8b --alt=gptx-3-8b-compact-int8 --prompts=orchid_exports.json --metrics=p95,perplexity,hallucination
```
Posting artifacts to cs/artifacts/orchid/ when done.
ops-bot: Provision request queued (req_id: orb-6222). ETA dedicated pool ready ~6m. Canary template: 5% for 2h -> 25% for 12h -> 75% for 24h gated by metrics.
Nora: Owners: Liam (eval + quality signoff), Ezra (routing + cache priming), Priya (quant profile + rollback policy). I'll coordinate CSM note after first 2h.
Liam: Eval results (60m): compact-int8 perplexity +0.9% (within threshold), hallucination spot-check OK (0/40 failures). Baseline p95 8.1s -> canary cohort 2.0s. Artifacts: https://console.redwood/cs/artifacts/orchid/6222222222
Ezra: Dedicated pool provisioned and routing rule deployed. Canary live at 03:24 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/obs/orchid/6222222222
ops-bot: Canary started. 5% export traffic -> dedicated-compact-int8-usw2. Health checks every 5m.
Priya: Early telemetry (first 30m): export cohort p95 down to ~2.1s; token throughput up ~3.6x. No quality alerts.
Nora: Great. We'll keep fallback active. If stable for 2h -> bump to 25% for 12h. Capture customer feedback + include a short note in renewal packet.
Liam: I'll bundle eval logs + regression checklist in the CS folder.
Ezra: Suggest a next-step optional: introduce micro-batching aggregator in the client SDK for export jobs to reduce request overhead further. Low-effort change on their side.
Nora: I'll propose that in the customer sync. Thanks all. Will update thread after 24h pass. :raised_hands:
